# Grave cross: a 0.22 square shaft 1.15 tall, a 0.7 arm, on a low base; leaning 10 degrees to its right. Up Z, front -Y.
new
add mesh cube --name Base --size 1 --location 0 0 0.08
scale 0.5 0.4 0.16
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Shaft --size 1 --location 0 0 0.72
scale 0.22 0.22 1.15
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0 0 0.95
scale 0.72 0.22 0.22
apply --scale
material new Stone --base-color 0.776 0.718 0.745
select Base Shaft Arm
material assign Stone
active Base
join
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
set rotation 0 10 0
apply --rotation
shade flat
export cross.glb
